sys.path.insert(0, '/root/cases/case_167')
import kernel

results = {}
for N in [1, 255, 256, 257, 1027, 131072]:
    x = torch.randint(0, 256, (N,), dtype=torch.uint8, device='cuda')
    out = kernel.run(x)
    ref = kernel.reference(x)
    results[N] = int((out != ref).sum())
# OOB check: run on small tensor and verify neighbors of a larger buffer untouched
buf = torch.randint(0, 256, (300,), dtype=torch.uint8, device='cuda')
before = buf.clone()
kernel.run(buf[:7])
oob = int((buf != before).sum())
print(json.dumps({"mismatch_by_N": results, "oob_writes_outside_slice": oob}))", "expected_signal": "all mismatch counts 0 and no OOB writes"}

fresh_shape = tuple(out.shape) == (N,) and out.dtype == torch.uint8 and out.is_contiguous()
# also verify reference of a wrong-offset read would differ (sanity that values vary)
print(json.dumps({"mismatch_count": mism, "input_mutated_bytes": input_mutated, "shares_storage_with_input": shares, "fresh_shape_dtype_contig": fresh_shape}))", "expected_signal": "mismatch 0, no mutation, no shared storage"}
